title: Magic Quality
description: This Currently only adds QOL recipes. However i plan on adding more things later on.
body:
# Magic Quality

A lightweight Fabric mod that adds practical recipes for items that feel like they should have been in vanilla Minecraft.

## Recipes

**Moss Block → Green Dye**

Smelt moss blocks in a furnace to produce green dye. A nice option if you have more moss than you know what to do with.

**4 Feathers → 2 Eggs**

Combine four feathers in any arrangement on a crafting table. Gives your chicken farm leftovers some purpose.

**Rotten Flesh → Leather (Campfire)**

Cook rotten flesh on a campfire for five seconds. Turns zombie drops into something actually useful.

**Snowball + Feather → Wind Charge**

A simple alternative recipe when breeze rods are hard to come by. Handy for knockback tricks.

**Totem of Undying**

Crafted with two emeralds, five gold ingots, and a golden apple. For those scared to fight an evoker :P
